percentages.title: Percentages - Complete Concept & Short Tricks
keyFormulas: Percentage Increase/Decrease = [(Final - Initial) / Initial] × 100
Consumption Reduction = [r / (100 + r)] × 100% when price rises by r%
Net Successive % Change = A + B + (A × B / 100)
percentages.keyConcepts: Understand percentage as a fraction out of 100. Master base-value shifting and multiplier methods (e.g., 25% increase = 1.25x).

profit-and-loss.title: Profit & Loss - Complete Concepts & Shortcut Tricks
keyFormulas: Profit % = (Profit / CP) × 100 | Loss % = (Loss / CP) × 100
Selling Price = Cost Price × [(100 ± Profit/Loss %) / 100]
Marked Price & Discount: SP = MP × [(100 - Discount %) / 100]
profit-and-loss.keyConcepts: Cost Price (CP) is always the 100% baseline. Profit or Loss is calculated on CP, whereas Discount is calculated on Marked Price (MP).

ratio-and-proportion.title: Ratio & Proportion - Fundamentals & Quick Rules
keyFormulas: Duplicate Ratio of a:b = a²:b²
Mean Proportional between a and b = √(a × b)
Product of Extremes = Product of Means: a × d = b × c
ratio-and-proportion.keyConcepts: Use constant multiplier x to represent components as ax, bx. Equal ratios can be combined by finding the LCM of common terms.

time-and-work.title: Time & Work - Efficiency & LCM Method Shortcuts
keyFormulas: Work Done = Rate × Time
Combined Time = (D1 × D2) / (D1 + D2)
Chain Rule: (M1 × D1 × H1) / W1 = (M2 × D2 × H2) / W2
time-and-work.keyConcepts: Assume Total Work = LCM of given days. Calculate daily efficiency units to quickly solve complex joint-work problems.

speed-and-distance.title: Speed, Time & Distance - Relative Speed & Train Problems
keyFormulas: Speed = Distance / Time
Conversion: 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s, 1 m/s = 18/5 km/h
Average Speed (equal distance) = (2 × S1 × S2) / (S1 + S2)
Relative Speed (Opposite) = S1 + S2 | Same Direction = |S1 - S2|
speed-and-distance.keyConcepts: When two objects move towards each other, add their speeds. When crossing a train or platform, total distance is the sum of their lengths.

interest.title: Simple & Compound Interest - Formulas & Shortcuts
keyFormulas: Simple Interest = (P × R × T) / 100
Compound Interest Amount = P × (1 + R/100)^T
2-Year CI - SI Difference = P × (R / 100)²
interest.keyConcepts: Simple Interest remains constant every year on principal. Compound interest accrues interest on interest.

probability.title: Probability - Fundamentals, Dice & Card Problems
keyFormulas: Probability P(E) = Favorable Outcomes / Total Outcomes
Complementary Event: P(E') = 1 - P(E)
Independent Events: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) × P(B)
probability.keyConcepts: Total probability is always between 0 and 1. When tossing n coins, total outcomes = 2^n; for n dice, total outcomes = 6^n.

permutations-and-combinations.title: Permutations & Combinations - Arrangement vs Selection
keyFormulas: Permutation (Arrangement): nPr = n! / (n - r)!
Combination (Selection): nCr = n! / [r! × (n - r)!]
Circular Permutation = (n - 1)!
permutations-and-combinations.keyConcepts: Use Permutations when ORDER matters (e.g. seated in a row). Use Combinations when order DOES NOT matter (e.g. forming a committee).

reading-comprehension.title: Verbal Ability - Reading Comprehension & Tone Strategies
keyFormulas: Skim for main idea → Scan for keywords → Infer tone and author intent
Transition contrast words: However, Nevertheless, Yet, Conversely
reading-comprehension.keyConcepts: Identify paragraph structure, distinguish stated facts from author inferences, and eliminate extreme options.

sentence-correction.title: Grammar & Sentence Correction Rules for GATE / Placements
keyFormulas: Subject-Verb Agreement: Singular subject takes singular verb.
Parallelism: Items in a list must match grammatical structures.
Correlative pairs: Neither...nor, Either...or, Hardly...when
sentence-correction.keyConcepts: Watch out for dangling modifiers and improper pronoun reference.

syllogisms.title: Logical Reasoning - Syllogisms & Venn Diagram Tricks
keyFormulas: All A are B → A ⊂ B
Some A are B → A ∩ B ≠ ∅
No A is B → A ∩ B = ∅
syllogisms.keyConcepts: Draw minimal overlap Venn diagrams. A conclusion is valid ONLY if it holds true in ALL possible Venn diagram representations.

blood-relations.title: Blood Relations - Family Tree Diagrams & Short Tricks
keyFormulas: Gender symbols: (+) for Male, (-) for Female
Generation level: Horizontal line for same generation, vertical for parents/children
blood-relations.keyConcepts: Always draw a family tree step-by-step from the central speaker or reference point.

data-interpretation.title: Data Interpretation - Tables, Bar Charts & Calculation Tricks
keyFormulas: % Increase = (Difference / Initial) × 100
Ratio comparison = Cross-multiplication method for fraction comparison
data-interpretation.keyConcepts: Master rapid estimation, fraction-to-percentage conversions, and weighted averages to solve DI sets quickly.

number-series.title: Number Series & Missing Pattern Recognition
keyFormulas: Check 1st Difference → 2nd Difference (Double Difference)
Check Squares & Cubes ± n
Check Alternate / Twin Series
number-series.keyConcepts: If numbers increase rapidly, look for multiplication/power series. If slow, look for addition/subtraction series.
